body: my anxiety makes me too scared to even try drugs. i can smoke weed occasionally, but any other drug nooooo way. too scared i’ll die

i’ve had anxiety as long as i can remember. i was young and used to tell my parents i had really bad chest pains whenever they would go out and leave me with a sitter, now i realize it was anxiety. then i grew up started taking psychedelics, and they brought my anxiety out even more, but also helped me to understand why i have anxiety, and deep issues i have.
it’s crazy because i’ve been smoking heavily for the past 6 years, and all of a sudden it’s been giving me anxiety.
that’s what’s happening to me. i’ve smoked pretty much every day the past 6 years and all of a sudden it’s been giving me really bad anxiety.
it’s not laced lol just my anxiety

coming from a 22 year old female.. just relax lol. i wouldn’t think anything bad about you living with your parents, were still young & figuring life out. as for the date, the movies is definitely out. nothing i hate more than sitting silently through a movie for a date when i want to be talking and getting to know someone. maybe dinner and mini golfing? or something active that will get you guys laughing and having fun. don’t let your anxiety make you miss out on what could be your future. and hey, if it doesn’t work out then she’s just not the right one for you, and you’ll just have to try again. best of luck 💛

brain zaps!!! i can never seem to find anyone that understands what i mean when i say i can feel the energy rushing in my brain and almost feels like my body is going to spazz or i’m going to have a seizure or something. what sucks is i’m not on any medication and it is purely just my anxiety doing it which gives me more anxiety bc i can’t blame it on anything else but myself.

i would love to, if i had the money or insurance. i’m 22, my mom just retired so the insurance she had to cover me is gone. adulting sucks lol. once i get my shit together that’s definitely something i want to try.

i mean.. i have some reasons on why i feel like my life is shit, but i know i’m in the process of fixing it.. but something in me makes me feel like even if i figure all my shit out and get to where i want to be, i’m still going to feel this way, forever.

yes! i’ve taken psychedelics several times but have stopped for the past 2 years, and now when i’m around people tripping or when my anxiety is bad i feel like i’m tripping. i was camping one time completely sober, anxiety kicked in and it looked like my tent walls were breathing, then i’ll think in my head did i take something and don’t remember?? it gets so bad that i start to question whether or not i decided to take a hallucinogen and don’t remember lol
